instruction: Restore the most recently closed browser tab.

metadata.explanation: Task variation using different hotel/travel booking websites (booking.com, agoda.com, expedia.com). User needs to recover the last closed tab (expedia.com) using Ctrl+Shift+T. Evaluator checks if all 3 tabs are open using the existing is_expected_tabs metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_open_tabs_info properly extracts all open Chrome tabs with URLs
Metric comparison logic is sound: is_expected_tabs correctly compares expected URLs with actual URLs using order-agnostic list comparison (are_lists_equal)
Complete instruction coverage: Evaluator verifies all 3 tabs are open, including the recovered expedia.com tab
Expected values are accurate: URLs match exactly what was configured in setup (booking.com, agoda.com, expedia.com)
URL comparison is robust: compare_urls function normalizes URLs properly (handles www, schemes, trailing slashes)
Data flow is semantically correct: Getter extracts tab info -> Metric extracts URLs -> Compares with expected using proper comparison function
